messages:
sarah: hey folks, first morning at Redwood! package arrived but keyboard (mechanical TKL) missing, monitor arm bracket screws were loose in the box, and when I try to join RedwoodCorp wifi the SSO keeps redirecting me back to the login. who should I ping for parts + network?
courier-bot: package PKG-9444 delivered to 4th floor desk 14 at 08:52. items: MacBook Pro, Dell 27, USB-C hub. missing: Keychron TKL keyboard.
ben_it: welcome Sarah :wave: sorry about that. i can drop a replacement Keychron to your desk. for the monitor arm — can you post a quick photo of the loose screw area? for the wifi loop, what browser and macOS are you on?
sarah: macOS 13.6.1, using Chrome. photo uploaded in thread (img). monitor arm post looks like the screw plate was rattling, can’t secure the vesa mount without the M4 screws staying put.
cecilia: hi! for Chrome SSO loops sometimes clearing the cookie for sso.redwood.example helps. try an incognito window and visit https://sso.redwood.example/status — if you see a 302 -> then a 400, paste the response. also try `sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder` and rejoin the network.
sarah: incognito shows 302 -> then a 401 Unauthorized after MFA. ran the mDNS command and rejoined, still loops.
ben_it: creating ticket and will do parts drop + remote debug. it-bot: ticket IT-7341 created and assigned to ben_it. ETA parts drop 2 hours.
ben_it: quick interim test: try joining RedwoodCorp on a phone as hotspot and connect laptop to that wifi — if SSO completes there it's likely our corporate proxy trimming auth headers. can you try?
sarah: joined phone hotspot, SSO went through fine and VPN connected. so looks proxy-related. thanks for the suggestion.
ben_it: confirmed in gateway logs that your initial auth hit the proxy and our edge rule was rewriting cookie domains for older clients. i've queued a change to preserve Secure cookie domain for SSO clients (PR: https://go/repo/infra/wifi-proxy/changes/309). rolling out now.
it-bot: infra change infra-309 deployed.
sarah: rejoined RedwoodCorp after deploy and SSO completed! no loop now. thanks.
ben_it: great — parts update: replacement Keychron reserved and VESA screw kit dispatched to desk 14, ETA 1h. also I'll schedule an on-site check for your monitor mount if you want us to tighten the bracket.
sarah: that would be great, please tighten the mount just to be safe. keyboard arrived an hour later and plugged in fine. monitor mount tightened by Ben and all secured. wifi + vpn stayed stable through a long meeting. really appreciate the quick help :tada:
ben_it: glad it's sorted — closing IT-7341 unless anything else pops up. ping this thread for follow-ups.
cecilia: welcome aboard again and happy first day!
